title: Yellow Garlicky Middle Eastern Bean Bowl
description: A flavorful and aromatic Middle Eastern dish featuring crispy beans, garlic, and char-grilled yang, served in a lacquerware bowl. This recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the garlic mixture.
Spread the chickpeas on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, or until crispy.
While the chickpeas are roasting, heat a small skillet over medium heat and char-grill the yang for 2-3 minutes on each side.
To assemble the bowls, divide the roasted chickpeas between two lacquerware bowls.
Top the chickpeas with char-grilled yang, chopped parsley, and a sprinkle of crushed red pepper, if using.
